text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/chat-completions above 3s for 4m (threshold=2.5s) — paging oncall.
maya: got the pager. seeing spike in region us-east-1 across models, qps normal.
chris: grabbing traces now. looks like KV cache misses increased around 02:12 UTC.
maya: confirmed. KV cache eviction rate jumped after a small rollout at 02:00. Rolling back?
chris: rollback pushed on canary, should hit all traffic in ~30s. monitoring p99.
sophia: FYI customers A and B opened support tickets about slow bot replies.
eli: adding temp squelch for p95 alerts on /v1/chat until we stabilize, will keep p99 active.
maya: please do. we want to avoid alert fatigue for p95 while we confirm root cause.
chris: p99 trending down after rollback: 3.2s -> 1.6s in last 60s. good sign.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0493 — Latency spike; severity: page; owner: maya
sophia: can we add a per-model p99 rule? the Mistral model had higher percentiles than others.
eli: agree. proposing per-route & per-model p99 thresholds: /v1/chat-completions@mistral p99=2.2s, default p99=2.8s.
maya: fine. make it a temporary override for 24h and create a dashboard panel for model split.
chris: I'm on it — patch for alerting rules:

```
- alert: HighP99ChatByModel
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat-completions"}[5m])) by (le, model)) > bool 2.2
  for: 3m
```

pushed to staging rules. will roll to prod after +1 from eli.
eli: +1, roll to prod.
maya: after prod roll, create dashboard link and add synthetic query for p99 per-route with quick link.
chris: deployed alert rule to prod, and created dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/abcd123/latency-model-split
sophia: added note to customer tickets that we're mitigating and rollback occurred, ETA 30m for follow-up.
maya: handing off on-call to chris, I'm OOO in 45m. leaving follow-ups: watch p99 over next 2h, ensure squelch removed when stable.
chris: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and escalate if p99 creeps above thresholds again.
eli: removed p95 noise alerts: `alert.patch.squelch(p95, /v1/chat-completions, 2h)` — will re-enable by automation after 2h unless cleared.
maya: thx team. we should schedule a postmortem on the KV eviction regression and add a runbook section for rollback cadence.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0493 updated: severity -> degraded, status -> monitoring
chris: closing the immediate pager; moving to post-incident action item thread.
